headline: Operating and net profit surge from last year
summary_short: Operating profit was KRW 7.94T, up 200.2% y/y, and net profit was KRW 12.53T, up 404.9% y/y but down 32.9% from last quarter.
summary_long: A Maeil Business report puts gains on investments in affiliates and joint ventures at KRW 6.55T against a small loss a year earlier. Yahoo EPS was KRW 94,935 against KRW 141,709 last quarter. Revenue could not be confirmed because reported figures did not reconcile. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Operating and net profit come from a search-result snippet of one news report; its revenue figure (KRW 304.8B) and growth rate did not reconcile with the shard (KRW 8.31T), so revenue is omitted. Net profit q/q uses the Yahoo shard value.
